description: This file contains a serializer codec for the IPAddress type in the Orleans framework, including methods for reading and writing IP addresses, and integrating with the serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: IPAddressCodec
classes.description: Serializer for IPAddress objects, implementing reading and writing logic for the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: IPAddressCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for IPAddress used in Orleans serialization, supporting derived type copying.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an IPAddress value from the buffer, handling reference tracking and raw deserialization.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads the raw, length-prefixed IP address bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an IPAddress field, with null-reference handling.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes the raw IP address bytes to the buffer with length prefix.
